<a id="body"></a>

## Body

Addendum to security verdict 45b9f78 (#325 at 9a77968), after alpaca's pointer. alarm_body joins retired ids with seat.as_str(), not pij_core::render::seat, and the result is delivered to every live PA and to death.mass. Exposure: the death sweep reaps only the LOCAL registry (reaper::reap_with_reason on services.registry), so remote/federated ids are not involved. Every id minted since F127 passes check_seat_id: spawn at http/mod.rs:1518, and a fresh registration at registration.rs:1196. A claim that lands on an existing row keeps that row's id, so only a pre-F127 legacy row could carry a non-canonical id, and F127 states every live id fits the grammar. So I see no live injection path, and the verdict stays pass. Still, it is the one daemon-authored PA message in this PR that does not go through the closed renderer, so as defence in depth: render each id with render::seat (and the harness from its closed enum, which it already is). new (low): alarm_body should use render::seat for retired ids.
